name: Corporate Action Option 1
definition: Provides information about the CA option.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

OptionAvailabilityStatus.name: Option Availability Status
OptionAvailabilityStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the option.

CertificationIndicator.name: Certification Indicator
CertificationIndicator.definition: Whether or not certification is required from the account owner. |Yes: certification required |No: no certification required.

CertificationType.name: Certification Type
CertificationType.definition: Type of certification which is required.

AssentedLineSecurityIdentification.name: Assented Line Security Identification
AssentedLineSecurityIdentification.definition: Identification of a temporary security used for processing reasons, eg, contra security used in the US.

AgentSecuritiesAccountIdentification.name: Agent Securities Account Identification
AgentSecuritiesAccountIdentification.definition: Identification of the safekeeping account held by an agent at the CSD.

AgentCashAccountIdentification.name: Agent Cash Account Identification
AgentCashAccountIdentification.definition: Identification of the cash account held by an agent at the CSD.

OfferType.name: Offer Type
OfferType.definition: Specifies the conditions that apply to the offer.

IntermediateSecuritiesDistributionType.name: Intermediate Securities Distribution Type
IntermediateSecuritiesDistributionType.definition: Type of intermediates securities distribution, eg, stock dividend, reverse right.

WithdrawalAllowedIndicator.name: Withdrawal Allowed Indicator
WithdrawalAllowedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether withdrawal of instruction is allowed.

ChangeAllowedIndicator.name: Change Allowed Indicator
ChangeAllowedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether change of instruction is allowed.

DateDetails.name: Date Details
DateDetails.definition: Provides information about the dates related to a CA option.

RateAndAmountDetails.name: Rate And Amount Details
RateAndAmountDetails.definition: Provides information about rates and amounts related to a CA option.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Provides information about the prices related to a CA option.

PeriodDetails.name: Period Details
PeriodDetails.definition: Provides information about the periods related to a CA option.

SecuritiesMovementDetails.name: Securities Movement Details
SecuritiesMovementDetails.definition: Provides information about the securities movement linked to the CA option.

CashMovementDetails.name: Cash Movement Details
CashMovementDetails.definition: Provides information about the cash movement linked to the CA option.

CorporateActionOtherAgentDetails.name: Corporate Action Other Agent Details
CorporateActionOtherAgentDetails.definition: Provides information about the agents linked to the CA option.

FractionDisposition.name: Fraction Disposition
FractionDisposition.definition: Specifies how fractions resulting from derived securities will be processed or how prorated decisions will be rounding, if provided with a pro ration rate.

OptionFeatures.name: Option Features
OptionFeatures.definition: Specifies the features that may apply to a corporate action option.

ChangeAllowedRule.definition: If the value of ChangeAllowedIndicator is true, then PerdioDetails/RevocabilityPeriod is Mandatory.

WithdrawalAllowedRule.definition: If the value of WithdrawalAllowedIndicator is true, then PeriodDetails/RevocabilityPeriod is Mandatory.
